editorial:
Gerard is fifty, out of work for three years, and running out of money when a job in Indonesia finally appears. To impress his new boss, he invites him to dinner, but his wife Colette panics and asks neighbor Alexandre, a communication guru, to transform their home and habits in one day. The movie really turns that pressure into a silly, fast-moving comedy about pretending to be perfect.

The fun comes from watching the couple try to keep up with Alexandre's wild makeover plans, from decor to uniforms and dinner details. It is light, silly, and easy to follow, though some jokes feel a bit over the top. The pacing stays quick, so the chaos never drags. If you enjoy awkward dinner comedies and underdog stories, this is a good pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the dinner goes off the rails as Gerard and Colette struggle to maintain their fake polished image. Alexandre's makeover cannot hide their real stress, and the boss sees through the act. Instead of losing everything, Gerard's honesty wins respect, and at the very end the couple finally learns that being themselves matters more than perfect appearances ever could.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves awkward dinner comedies and underdog stories.
